ledger.note: Read the EIA August 2026 entry for the Maiden Lateral Expansion (1997, North Carolina, 18 miles). EIA gives no LNG tie. One search found no LNG link. Left blank.
Read the EIA entries for Mid-South Expansion Phases 1 and 2 (2012 and 2013, Alabama to North Carolina). EIA gives no LNG tie. The existing EIA ref was checked. No LNG link found. Left blank.

Read the EIA entry and the 1997 Federal Register notice for the Mobile Bay Lateral Expansion Phase 1. Neither names an LNG tie. One search for Mobile Bay lateral LNG export returned only 2007 to 2010 LNG import material (Pascagoula, Gulf LNG Clean Energy). That import link is not an export tie. Left blank with a note.

Read the EIA entries for Momentum Phases I and II and the Federal Register notices on FERC docket CP01-388. No LNG tie in them. One search on Momentum and LNG export found only a 2026 Williams deal for Momentum Midstream, which is a different asset. Left blank.

Read the EIA entries and the Williams April 2026 groundbreaking release. The project delivers to New York City utilities (National Grid). No source ties it to LNG export. The existing refs were checked. Left blank.
Read the EIA August 2026 entry for the Potomac Expansion (2007, North Carolina and Maryland). EIA gives no LNG tie. Left blank.
Read the EIA entry for the Rivervale South to Market Project (New Jersey, 0.61 miles). EIA says it moves supply to the Manhattan meter station and the Mercer pool. No LNG tie. Left blank.

Main line row for Transco. Several Transco expansions feed LNG terminals, including the Gulf Connector, Gulf Trace and Texas to Louisiana Energy Pathway. Those are separate rows, not this mainline. No source found says the mainline itself delivers gas to a terminal. The EIA Wharton West entry is related but not an LNG tie. Left blank.
Read the EIA entry and the Federal Register notices for the SouthCoast Expansion (2000, Alabama to Georgia). No LNG tie. Left blank.

Checked the EIA entry and the existing refs. One search reported Golden Pass LNG and Delfin LNG as anchor customers. Those words appear in an OGJ article, but they describe the NGPL Texas-Louisiana Expansion Project, a different pipeline. No validated source ties the Southeast Supply Enhancement project to LNG export. Anchor shipper accounts also conflict: a Williams-linked account names EOG Resources. Left blank.
Read the EIA entry and the Federal Register notices for the Sundance Expansion (2002, Louisiana to Virginia). One search found the project served Southeast power plants and LDCs, not LNG. Left blank.
Read the EIA entry and the 2012 Federal Register notice for FERC docket CP13-30 (Virginia Southside). No LNG tie in them. Left blank.

Read the EIA entry for the TW San Juan 2005 Expansion. One search found shippers BP and ConocoPhillips and no LNG tie. A 2005 Southern Union presentation mentions LNG, but it concerns the Trunkline LNG terminal business, not this lateral. Left blank.
Read the EIA entry for the TW San Juan Lateral Expansion (2008, New Mexico). No LNG tie found. The same search as P8292 turned up no LNG link. Left blank.

Read the EIA entry for the Tres Palacios Copano Interconnect (2013, Texas). An August 2026 Enbridge release ties the Tres Palacios storage site to the TTC Connector pipeline for Freeport LNG. That is a different pipeline, not this interconnect, so no tie. Left blank.
Read the EIA entry for the Tres Palacios Storage Lateral (2008, Texas). The Enbridge TTC Connector release concerns a different pipeline. No LNG tie found for this lateral. Left blank.
Read the EIA entry for the Tri-State Corridor Pipeline Project. EIA says it is shelved and on hold, serving a power plant. No LNG tie. Left blank.

Main line row for Trunkline Gas. Older NGI coverage says Trunkline planned a short extension to feed the Lake Charles liquefaction project. That extension is an expansion, not this main line, and the expansion row is not in this chunk. The mainline row is left blank.
Read the existing refs (2018 to 2019 Xcel documents and a Daily Camera article) and the row notes. A Colorado distribution line with no LNG link. Left blank.
Read the existing refs (TC Energy Tuscarora pages). The line runs from Malin, Oregon to Wadsworth, Nevada, and the Tuscarora Xpress project serves Reno. No LNG tie. Left blank.
